Our word data is sourced from Wiktionary, the free multilingual dictionary built by volunteers worldwide.
We use pre-processed dictionary data from Kaikki.org, extracted from Wiktionary using the open-source wiktextract tool by Tatu Ylonen.
Application source code is available under BUSL-1.1.
We use a Kotlin port of FSRS-Kotlin, provided under the MIT License. FSRS was originally developed by Jarrett Ye with the Open Spaced Repetition community.
All words data is available under CC-BY-SA-4.0 license.
We are grateful to the Wiktionary community and to Tatu Ylonen for making this data freely available.
